messages:
maria: quick follow-up from today's RFC review: we need an escalation path for repeating advisory failures. not every advisory should be noise.
dan: agreed. proposal: advisory_count window -> escalate. e.g., if advisory from same plugin appears 3x in 14 days, flip to require-review.
lee: implementation note: store rolling counts in the model metadata and emit a webhook when threshold crossed so owners get pinged. also TTL on advisories so old ones decay.
sasha: also define 'silence' rules per-plugin. teams can silence transient advisories for specific models with an opt-in comment that records rationale. but silenced advisories still count toward metrics.
maria: good. UI: Console should show a compact history: last 30 days of advisory events with counts and an 'escalate' button.
dan: for automation, add an onboarding policy file in repo: {escalation_rules: [{plugin: kv-cache-smoke, count:3, window_days:14}], owners: [...]}. policy overrides org defaults.
eng-bot: escalation rule saved to ONBOARD-825. assigned: dan.
sasha: security reminder: plugins must never call external endpoints unless explicitly allowed by model policy. otherwise advisories might leak signals. sandbox enforced at runner layer.
lee: i'll add decay logic to job-pool spike. plan: exponential decay with half-life measured in days.
maria: thanks—combine these points into RFC v2. owners: dan (aggregator rules), lee (decay & job-pool), sasha (manifest + sandbox). aim for RFC in 2 weeks.
